outlet: Journal of the San Juan Islands, 'LWV Observer Corps notes on public meetings', June 17, 2026
notes: Friday Harbor Town Council, June 4, 2026: Resolution 3027 hires consultant Heather Lee for a comprehensive operational assessment of the town finance department, not to exceed $25,000. County Council, May 27: the Auditor's Office presented on the budget shortfall after the failed levy lid lift.
